selection_manifest_status: No pre-existing citation selection manifest found in recursive main branch tree. This pilot records its own exact six-document selection.
selection_method: Inspected content from 8 of 20 actual PDFs via PyMuPDF text, page metadata, and rendered page images; selected 6 PDFs and 8 cases.
page_number_rule: pdf_page_number_1_based is the physical page in the original PDF. printed_page_label may differ and is informational.
quote_rules: For extractable text, exact_supporting_passage is a verbatim substring of PyMuPDF page.get_text('text',sort=True), and pages were visually checked. For image-only or noisy OCR, text is explicitly marked visual transcription requiring review.
verdict_policy: Cite precise claim, entity, time period, and table coordinate. Valid-looking incorrect passages are negatives even when topic, row label, or header matches.

cases.question: What was Tata Motors Group's consolidated revenue from operations for Q3 FY25 (quarter ended December 31, 2024)?

expected_citation_location.region: Financials table, Revenue from operations row, far-right Consolidated column

cases.supporting_context_exact: Consolidated                                                                              Quarter ended December 31, 2024                ₹ Cr. IndAS

plausible_incorrect_citation.context_exact: Consolidated                                                                              Quarter ended December 31, 2023                 Rs Cr. IndAS
plausible_incorrect_citation.why_it_does_not_support: Page 46 is the Q3 FY24 quarter ended December 31, 2023, not Q3 FY25. The identical row label and table structure do not make its 1,10,577 value support the 2024 quarter claim.

cases.question: What was the growth index for Distribution Transformer for Apr–Dec 2023 compared with Apr–Dec 2022 in the IEEMA overview?
cases.expected_answer_or_claim: 34.6 (growth index, percent comparison shown in chart)

expected_citation_location.region: Detailed Growth Index for Electrical Equipment Industry, left-hand table, Distribution Transformer row

cases.supporting_context_exact: Detailed Growth Index for Electrical Equipment Industry
cases.note: The PDF heading expresses a comparison period; use the value 34.6, not the adjacent LVSWGR value 14.8 in the right-hand table.

cases.question: According to ECOS India Mobility's DRHP addendum, what was Rajesh Loomba's post-Offer shareholding percentage, assuming all shares in the Offer were sold?

expected_citation_location.region: Offer Document Summary, first shareholding table, Rajesh Loomba row, Post-Offer Equity Share Capital percentage column

plausible_incorrect_citation.why_it_does_not_support: 26.50% is the post-Offer holding of Aditya Loomba, not Rajesh Loomba. This is the same table and same metric but the wrong shareholder row.

cases.question: On the original Airo Lam IPO application, which form is the bidder's undertaking for?
cases.exact_supporting_passage: BIDDER’S UNDERTAKING FOR BID CUM APPLICATION FORM

expected_citation_location.region: Top black header bar, line immediately below the common abridged-prospectus heading

repeated_text_decoy.shared_repeated_header_exact: IN THE NATURE OF ABRIDGED PROSPECTUS – MEMORANDUM CONTAINING SALIENT FEATURES OF THE
repeated_text_decoy.why_it_does_not_support: The generic abridged-prospectus heading is identical on both pages, but the later page explicitly identifies a Revision Form rather than the original Bid Cum Application Form.
